blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Transport group Manibela branded US President Donald Trump the “king of wars” and “king of oil price hikes” on Tuesday, Nov. 17, blaming his administration’s role in armed conflicts for driving up fuel prices in the Philippines. Manibela president Mar Valbuena made the remarks as the group staged a demonstration against Trump’s expected arrival in the country for the 49th Asean Summit. “[He is] the reason why we are suffering today, especially the transport sector, where his war has provided a way for oil companies to take advantage and raise the prices of petroleum products,” Valbuena told the Inquirer.
